title: x-ui
description: UI automation hints for Arazzo scenario steps. Consumed by the LLM-driven exploratory runner (reads actions[].text and expect) and Playwright test generator (reads selectors[].playwright). Each selector references an action by id for rename-safe binding. See Arazzo Handbook §5.3.

platform.description: Target platform for this step. Default: any

page.description: The page or route where this step takes place (e.g., '/orders/my-orders')

actions.description: Ordered list of user-facing actions for this step

expect.description: Expected visual outcomes after the step completes

selectors.description: Optional Playwright selector hints. Each selector references an action by its id.

captureScreenshot.description: Whether to capture a screenshot after this step. Default: false

text.description: Natural-language description for LLM agent and tutorial prose

action.description: A user-facing action within the step

for.description: Must reference an existing actions[].id in the same step. Dangling references are a Spectral error.

selector.description: A Playwright selector hint bound to a specific action by its id
